_comment: n8n fabric process workflows (AGENTS.md §23.23 10.0.0 ACTIVE: n8n owns FLOW, the host owns authority and evidence). One entry per business process the fabric owns or is about to own. The generator (scripts/n8n_workflow_templates.py build-fabric) reads this file plus the process's PipelineManifest@v1 (step order, stage schedules) and config/n8n_run_allowlist.json (per-step timeout) and renders one inactive workflow per process into docs/implementation/n8n-maturity/workflows/fabric/. Every runnable step calls the published Run Lane sub-workflow; a BLOCKED step never calls it and is recorded as status 'blocked' with its reason. depends_on names steps of the SAME stage that come EARLIER in the manifest (the shell runner's order stays a valid topological order, so shadow parity is comparable). mode is what the workflow requests: 'dry_run' until the cutover PR changes it (the executor's stage clamp also forces dry_run while a lane is at stage shadow). The step lanes, their allowlist entries, health contracts and effect keys are reviewed in the same PR as this file (packet docs/ops/packets/n8n-hermes-learning-flow-20261015/).
_comment_unblock_20261015: 2026-10-15 unblock (branch n8nfab/hermes-learning-unblock-20261015): tag_engine (--dry-run makes no model call), outcome_feedback_agent (sends are declared chokepoint intents; --dry-run never notifies; --notify record calls no sender) and autonomous_self_tune (--learn half only: the purge helpers refuse in that mode) became dry-run shadow lanes. score_history_retention stays BLOCKED: destructive retention, an operator decision; it stays on cron and is excluded from the fabric process. Per-step keys the generator reads: lane_id, depends_on, blocked, max_attempts (optional, default default_max_attempts), outcome_timeout_s (optional; only LOWERS Run Lane's wait, step timeout + 120 s capped at 1000 s). lane_extra_args is documentation the tests check: argv the step lane adds to the manifest step's command (the cron step keeps its own argv). default_max_attempts 1 (was 2): with six runnable steps the manual all-stages run's worst case must fit the 3600 s execution timeout (n8n EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT_MAX); 420+1000+420+420+720+600 = 3580 s.
_comment_prereqs_20261015: 2026-10-15 cutover prerequisites (branch n8nfab/hermes-learning-prereqs-20261015; packet docs/ops/packets/hermes-learning-cutover-20261015/). live_manual_slots (process): false = the gateway accepts a LIVE p: key only for the step's scheduled stage slot (the same slot the cron runner's effect key uses); true lets a manual minute run live (an operator flag for a proof run, never left on). cutover_live_arg (step): the argv the cutover PR sets as the step lane's allowlist live_arg; documentation the tests check, never read by the executor (live_arg stays null until the cutover PR). The gateway validates every p: key against this file + the manifest (scripts/lib/n8n_process_keys.py).

tag_engine.dry_run: --dry-run: no model call (generate_cloud never imported; the rows the live run would classify are counted in retag.llm_would_call), read-only DB session, no DDL (scripts/hermes_tag_engine.py run/retag/tag_efficacy).

outcome_feedback_agent.dry_run: --dry-run: read-only DB session, writes nothing, never reaches the notifier. Live (cron) sends are declared intents through the host chokepoint send_telegram(priority P2/P3, producer hermes_outcome_feedback_agent); --notify record returns the intents and calls no sender.

score_history_retention.blocked: EXCLUDED, OPERATOR DECISION (destructive retention, never-list): --apply runs DELETE FROM hermes_score_history (scripts/hermes_score_history_retention.py --days 21). It stays on cron as a retention concern and is excluded from the fabric process: not changed by the 2026-10-15 unblock; moving retention into n8n at all is an operator decision (AGENTS.md §17, §23.14). Ordered after outcome_grader because the grader freezes score components before retention can delete them.

autonomous_self_tune.dry_run: --learn --dry-run: auto-graft preview only (self_purge never called; the purge helpers raise LearnOnlyViolation in learn-only mode), read-only DB session, no CREATE TABLE, no weights-file write. The purge half (--purge) stays host cron retention.
